context_title:
Create a cinematic, photorealistic head-and-shoulders portrait of a young adult with short platinum-white hair. Hair is bleached white with a faint silvery sheen, cut very short at the temples and nape with slightly longer, textured strands on top brushed gently forward; single hair strands visible, slightly separated, fine texture with natural split ends and subtle root shadow. Skin is pale with cool, neutral undertones — porcelain with faint warm capillary redness at the nostrils and on the upper cheeks. Visible skin microtexture: medium-size pores on the nose and cheeks, a few barely visible blemishes and faint healed acne marks on the lower cheeks, soft peach fuzz on jawline, scattered tiny sebaceous glints on the forehead and nose where light catches.

Eyes are almond-to-oval in shape, relaxed, neutral expression; irises a desaturated gray-brown with fine radial striations and small, natural flecks; pupils round and centered, catchlights present: a small rectangular softbox reflection at the 11 o’clock position and a slimmer highlight from a phone screen at 5 o’clock. Eyelids are smooth with a shallow crease; upper eyelashes are short and sparse, slightly curved; lower lashes are finer and sparse. Eyebrows are dark brown, thin to medium thickness, slightly arched with a natural taper toward the tail, individual hairs visible and occasionally sketched against the skin.

Nose is straight with a gently rounded tip; nasal bridge smooth, slight natural shadow at the root and subtle highlights down the ridge; nostrils are symmetrical and moderately narrow. Lips are medium-thin, neutral-toned pinkish-beige, well-defined vermilion border, soft highlight along the lower lip center; philtrum shallow but discernible. Jawline is defined and angular but not exaggerated; soft shadow under the jaw where neck meets skull; visible tendons lightly defined with neutral head posture. Chin is slightly rounded, proportionate to lower face.

Ears are visible (one more prominent in some angles), medium sized, with defined helix, antihelix and lobule; ear skin matches facial skin tone with very fine vellus hairs at the rim. Neck skin shows faint transverse lines from posture, very fine veins visible near the clavicle; subtle collarbone shadow.

Clothing visible: black T-shirt with small white logo at chest; fabric shows soft wear and tiny lint particles. Environment and lighting: overcast natural light filtered through a car window (soft, diffused key light from the left/front), producing gentle, even illumination across the face with milky soft shadows; a secondary cool fill from interior ambient light (phone screen / cabin lights) reduces contrast on the shadow side. Small raindrops dot the car window in the background, slightly out of focus bokeh. Depth of field: shallow, face in sharp focus, background softly blurred. Rendering style: hyper-real photographic — 35–50mm focal feel, subtle grain, high dynamic range, crisp detail on skin pores and hair strands, realistic lens subtle vignetting and natural reflectivity in eyes
